stages.name: draft
stages.prompt:
本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve，金额超过 50000 的采购单进入 pending-second，等待另一位审批人会签）、会签（POST /purchases/{id}/countersign）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增退回：第二位审批人可以把一张等待会签的采购单退回给申请人补充材料。接口为 POST /purchases/{id}/return，请求体严格为 {"reason":"..."}，reason 为 1..200 字节，说明退回原因。只有已认证的 approver 可以调用。目标必须是当前租户中他人创建、状态为 pending-second 的采购单；把这张采购单批到 pending-second 的那位审批人不能退回它，只有另一位审批人可以。成功后该采购单 status 变为 returned，其他列都不变。找不到目标、目标属于其他租户、由调用者本人创建、状态不是 pending-second、或调用者正是批到 pending-second 的那位审批人时，返回 4xx，数据库全部不变。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Item 完成（verb 为 return，role 为 approver），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"id":ID,"status":"returned"}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一目标时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同目标返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与退回在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "return.v8"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 同时退回同一采购单时恰好一个返回 200、另一个返回 4xx，只退回一次。退回后的采购单不能再被会签、批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交或改派（4xx，数据库不变）。requester 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、会签、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。
This is the first of two separate sessions for the return Action described above. In this session you write its operation catalog entry; a later, separate session writes the adapter code that serves it through the kernel.
Capability: internal/opkernel executes entries of the operation catalog internal/opdef. internal/opdef/opdef.go defines the entry type, its fields and their validation; internal/opdef/catalog.go holds the entries. The catalog does not yet contain an entry for this Action.
Read the requirements above, the existing entries, the platform code (internal/opdef, internal/opkernel) and the rest of the service (SCHEMA.sql, internal/) and derive every field of the new entry from them.
Only edit internal/opdef/catalog.go: add exactly one entry for this Action (and its Name constant). Do not change the existing entries, do not write adapter code, and leave every other file unchanged when you finish.
The entry must pass opdef.Validate(), which opkernel.New calls at startup. If the catalog does not compile or does not validate when you finish, the trial ends there.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.

You are reviewing a draft operation catalog entry before it is frozen. In a previous session, another agent added the entry for the return Action described above to internal/opdef/catalog.go (the last commit; see git show HEAD -- internal/opdef/catalog.go). stages.prompt:
本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve，金额超过 50000 的采购单进入 pending-second，等待另一位审批人会签）、会签（POST /purchases/{id}/countersign）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增退回：第二位审批人可以把一张等待会签的采购单退回给申请人补充材料。接口为 POST /purchases/{id}/return，请求体严格为 {"reason":"..."}，reason 为 1..200 字节，说明退回原因。只有已认证的 approver 可以调用。目标必须是当前租户中他人创建、状态为 pending-second 的采购单；把这张采购单批到 pending-second 的那位审批人不能退回它，只有另一位审批人可以。成功后该采购单 status 变为 returned，其他列都不变。找不到目标、目标属于其他租户、由调用者本人创建、状态不是 pending-second、或调用者正是批到 pending-second 的那位审批人时，返回 4xx，数据库全部不变。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Item 完成（verb 为 return，role 为 approver），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"id":ID,"status":"returned"}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一目标时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同目标返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与退回在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "return.v8"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 同时退回同一采购单时恰好一个返回 200、另一个返回 4xx，只退回一次。退回后的采购单不能再被会签、批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交或改派（4xx，数据库不变）。requester 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、会签、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。
Add the return Action described above to the existing service.
Read the existing code first and follow its conventions.
The database uses guarded RLS. The shared HTTP adapter in internal/protocol validates input and binds demo identity; register the new path with protocol.Item.
Only edit/add internal/candidate/ Go code. All other exports, dependencies, Git settings and tests are protected.
Preserve the existing APIs, including bulk-approve, countersign, bulk-reject, reopen and bulk-reassign.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
Use go build ./... and go test ./... as needed. Private database credentials are unavailable during generation. The public SQL schema is in SCHEMA.sql.
Capability: protected internal/opdef is the reviewed operation catalog and already contains the entry for the operation in this task; protected internal/opkernel executes catalog entries: New(ctx,pool), Request and Executor.Run(ctx,identity,name,key,request). The existing operations are served through the kernel by internal/candidate; serve the new one the same way. opkernel.Rejection is distinct from protocol.Rejection; adapt at your boundary.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.

isolation: operator must isolate generation from evaluator; commands alone do not enforce it
